htf.label: Structure chart (minutes)
htf.description: Higher-timeframe bar size used for the double-BOS arm (Mike trades the 15m).

ltf.label: Entry chart (minutes)
ltf.description: Lower-timeframe bar size used for the entry trigger BOS, stops and trails (Mike trades the 3m).

pivotStrengthHtf.label: Structure-chart swing strength (bars each side)
pivotStrengthHtf.description: Swing pivot strength on the HTF: a pivot high/low must beat this many bars on each side; confirmed that many bars later (no lookahead).

pivotStrengthLtf.label: Entry-chart swing strength (bars each side)
pivotStrengthLtf.description: Swing pivot strength on the LTF (entry BOS + stop placement). Champion uses 1.

rr.label: Fixed target (R)
rr.description: Take-profit as a multiple of risk. Only used by exitModel fixed_rr.

exitModel.label: Exit style: {exitModel:fixed_rr=take profit at a fixed target|trail_ltf=trail the stop behind confirmed swings|liquidity_v1=aim for the last liquidity point, trail behind swings as a backstop|liquidity_v2=exit on an opposite break after a liquidity pool is tapped|opposite_bos=exit on any opposite break|combo=target first, then trail}
exitModel.description: How winners are closed: fixed_rr (rr x risk), trail_ltf (structure trail behind LTF swings), liquidity_v1 (terminal-liquidity TP + trail), liquidity_v2 (pools tapped then opposite BOS), opposite_bos (any opposite LTF BOS), combo (terminal TP + optional trail/opp-BOS).

trailPadUsd.label: Trail padding beyond the swing ($)
trailPadUsd.description: Pad placed beyond the trailing swing when a trail ratchets the stop.

requireSweep.label: Require a liquidity sweep between the two breaks (older switch; the pullback rule above overrides it)
requireSweep.description: Legacy switch (superseded by armMode): when armMode is absent, true arms only sweep-type pullbacks.

armMode.label: Pullback kind: {armMode:either=both kinds of pullback|sweep=only pullbacks that run the prior swing|retrace=only pullbacks that stop short of the prior swing}
armMode.description: Which double-BOS pullback variants arm: sweep (pullback ran the prior swing's liquidity), retrace (it did not), or either (Mike: both are valid).

maxEntriesPerArm.label: Entries allowed per setup
maxEntriesPerArm.description: Sequential entry attempts allowed off one arm (Mike took 3 on Jul 2; champion uses 3).

maxConcurrent.label: Positions open at once
maxConcurrent.description: Open positions allowed at once. 1 = classic single-position; >1 = pyramiding on further same-direction LTF BOS.

addGateR.label: Add to a position only when it is up by (R)
addGateR.description: Pyramiding gate: only add when every open position is at least this many R in profit. null = no gate.

beAtR.label: Move the stop to breakeven at (R)
beAtR.description: Breakeven ratchet: once unrealized R reaches this, the stop jumps to entry. null = off.

slPaddingUsd.label: Stop padding beyond the swing ($)
slPaddingUsd.description: Pad beyond the protecting LTF swing when placing the initial stop.

maxSlUsd.label: Widest stop allowed ($)
maxSlUsd.description: Skip setups whose entry-to-stop distance exceeds this (and anything under 0.50 USD is always skipped).

spreadUsd.label: Spread charged per trade ($)
spreadUsd.description: Cost model: spread charged on the buy side of entry/exit.

slippageUsd.label: Slippage charged per fill ($)
slippageUsd.description: Cost model: slippage charged on every fill.

armExpiryHtfBars.label: Setup expires after (structure-chart bars)
armExpiryHtfBars.description: An arm goes stale after this many HTF bars without a trigger.

liquidityLookbackDays.label: Liquidity lookback (days)
liquidityLookbackDays.description: How far back to look for prior-traverse HTF pivots when finding terminal liquidity / pools (liquidity_v1, liquidity_v2, opposite_bos, combo).

tpBufferUsd.label: Take profit this far before the liquidity level ($)
tpBufferUsd.description: Front-run the terminal liquidity level by this much (and the pool-tap tolerance in liquidity_v2).

minProfitRForOppExit.label: Opposite-break exit only if up by (R)
minProfitRForOppExit.description: An opposite LTF BOS only closes the trade when unrealized R is at least this (opposite_bos, liquidity_v2, combo).

useOppBos.label: Also exit on an opposite break (target-then-trail style only)
useOppBos.description: combo only: also exit on an opposite LTF BOS.

useTerminalTp.label: Use the terminal target (target-then-trail style only)
useTerminalTp.description: combo only: place the terminal-liquidity take-profit (false = trail/opp-BOS only).

trailActivateR.label: Start trailing after (R)
trailActivateR.description: combo only: the structure trail switches on once unrealized R reaches this.

useEmaExit.label: Exit winners at the structure-chart EMA wall
useEmaExit.description: 15m EMA wall exit (Mike): close winners approaching the HTF EMA when it sits in the trade's path.

emaPeriod.label: EMA length (structure-chart bars)
emaPeriod.description: EMA period on the HTF for the EMA wall exit.

emaProxUsd.label: How close to the EMA counts ($)
emaProxUsd.description: EMA wall exit: how close to the EMA price must come before exiting.

emaMinProfitR.label: EMA exit only if up by (R)
emaMinProfitR.description: EMA wall exit only fires when unrealized R is at least this.

emaOnlyWhenNoTerminal.label: EMA exit only when there is no liquidity target
emaOnlyWhenNoTerminal.description: EMA wall exit only when the trade has no terminal take-profit.

exitBosStrength.label: Swing strength for the opposite-break exit (blank = same as the entry chart)
exitBosStrength.description: Pivot strength for the exit-BOS stream (stricter than entries filters noise breaks). null = same as pivotStrengthLtf.

trailMode.label: Trail behind: {trailMode:pivot=entry-chart swings|htf_pivot=structure-chart swings|chandelier=an ATR distance}
trailMode.description: Trail source: LTF swing pivots, HTF swing pivots, or an ATR(14) chandelier.

trailPivotStrength.label: Trail swing strength (blank = same as the entry chart)
trailPivotStrength.description: trailMode pivot: pivot strength for the (possibly looser) trail swings. null = same as pivotStrengthLtf.

atrMult.label: ATR distance for the chandelier trail (multiples of ATR)
atrMult.description: trailMode chandelier: ATR(14) multiple behind the extreme.

windows.label: Trading sessions (PT hours)
windows.description: Session windows in PT hours (PT = server - 10h). Entries only inside a window; positions flatten at window end. The bench sets this from the active risk profile's sessions.
